The Bachelor The Bachelorette Bachelor in Paradise The Bachelor: Listen to Your Heart The Bachelor The Bachelorette Bachelor Pad Bachelor in Paradise Males Females The Bachelorette (Season 22) The 22nd season of The Bachelorette was supposed to premiere on March 22, 2026. The season would have featured 31-year-old Taylor Frankie Paul, a single mom and reality TV star. She is the first ever Bachelorette to have not appeared on a previous season of The Bachelor. On March 19, 2026, the season was pulled from the air after a video from 2023, of Taylor and her then-boyfriend in a physical altercation taking place in front of her daughter, surfaced online. A Disney Entertainment Television spokesperson said in a statement Thursday, March 19, "In light of the newly released video just surfaced today, we have made the decision to not move forward with the new season of The Bachelorette at this time, and our focus is on supporting the family."
